claims.source_title: Voice 2. Jitter
claims.supported_claim: local jitter比较相邻周期时长，通常在长持续元音测量
claims.study_scope: 周期可定位的持续语音段；官方算法文档
claims.limitations: 不把帧级F0残差或歌曲任意段落的波动当生理jitter；不移植临床阈值

claims.source_title: Voice 3. Shimmer

claims.study_scope: 长持续元音；官方定义
claims.limitations: 30/50ms包络AM不是相邻周期幅度扰动；新增ACO:L5候选，检测未实现

claims.source_title: PointProcess: Get jitter (local)...

claims.limitations: 未通过周期定位验证就不报告数值；筛选后分子/分母有效集合须按算法实现

claims.source_title: Voice 4. Additive noise

claims.study_scope: 周期信号加噪框架
claims.limitations: 不能把摩擦音、强不规则段或所有CPP代理读作真实漏气比例

claims.source_title: Sound: To Formant (burg)...

claims.study_scope: 该具体Praat Burg实现
claims.limitations: 不能将任意程序25ms窗与此设置视作同窗；LPC结果不是自动真实声道真值

claims.source_title: Dark tone quality and vocal tract shaping in soprano song production: Insights from real-time MRI

claims.source_title: Dark tone quality and vocal tract shaping in soprano song production: Insights from real-time MRI

claims.source_title: Sound: Get root-mean-square...

claims.source_title: Perceptual interaction of the harmonic source and noise in voice
